emotional_tone: Authoritative, serene, structured, and culturally rooted.

background.description: Warm, earthy off-white to reduce eye strain for content editors.

surface.description: Pure white for content cards and tables to maintain high contrast.

primary.description: Saffron/Bhagwa accent. Used sparingly for primary CTAs (e.g., 'Publish', 'Upload Docs').

secondary.description: Deep charcoal for secondary actions and heavy data headers.

scale.h1: text-3xl md:text-4xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight text-stone-900
scale.h2: text-xl md:text-2xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight text-stone-900
scale.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-stone-500

spacing_and_layout.sidebar: w-64 fixed h-full border-r border-stone-200 bg-stone-50 z-40
spacing_and_layout.topbar: h-16 border-b border-stone-200 bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl sticky top-0 z-30 flex items-center px-6

multilingual_editor_layout.structure: Split pane. Left: Source (Sanskrit/Hindi). Right: Target Language Editor. Language selector must be a scrollable horizontal Shadcn Tab bar.

surfaces_and_borders.table_header: bg-stone-50 border-b border-stone-200 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-stone-500 font-semibold py-3 px-4
surfaces_and_borders.table_cell: border-b border-stone-100 py-3 px-4 text-sm text-stone-700
surfaces_and_borders.inputs: bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:bg-white transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500/30
surfaces_and_borders.dropdowns: bg-white border border-stone-200 shadow-lg rounded-lg overflow-hidden

modifications: Buttons: rounded-lg. Primary button uses Saffron (orange-600).
Tabs: h-auto instead of fixed h-9. bg-stone-100 for the list, with white active tab and orange-600 active text.
Cards: Remove heavy shadows, rely on 1px border-stone-200.
Badges: Soft variations. bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 for 'Draft'. bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 for 'Published'.

custom_patterns.verse_manager: Inline word mapping using Shadcn Badges. Wrap words in clickable badges to open a popover for meaning entry.
custom_patterns.import_wizard: Stepper component with file upload dropzone. Dropzone should be dashed border-stone-300 bg-stone-50 hover:bg-stone-100 p-12 text-center.

motion_and_interaction.accessibility: Always explicit focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-orange-500).

icons.usage: Use size 20 for standard inline icons, 24 for sidebar.

login_background.description: Minimalist spiritual background with an incense holder on a warm backdrop. Perfect for the Admin Panel login screen.

default_granth_cover.description: Vibrant traditional Hindu items (diyas, fabric). Use as a placeholder cover for Sacred Texts or Bhakti Categories if no image is uploaded.

om_symbol_placeholder.description: Monochrome Om symbol texture for generic spiritual placeholders or empty states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts in index.html.
Set up Tailwind config with custom font families (sans: Manrope, serif: Cormorant Garamond) and the exact colors defined above.
Implement the 'Control Room' grid layout for the main dashboard (dense, highly utilized space).
Sidebar must be persistent on desktop, tucked into a hamburger menu on mobile.
For the Multilingual Tabs, use Shadcn Tabs but override strict heights. Ensure it gracefully scrolls horizontally if 12+ languages are loaded.
The Verse Manager is critical: use a split-screen or side-by-side card layout to compare original Sanskrit against the selected language translation.
Do NOT use raw HTML `<select>` or `<input type="date">`. Strictly use Shadcn Select, DropdownMenu, and Calendar.
Use Phosphor Icons (Duotone) for sidebar navigation and action buttons.
Login screen should be a 50/50 split layout. Left side: The login form (clean, centered). Right side: The `login_background` image covering the full height.
Ensure the Panchang Settings and VedaChat settings use Shadcn Forms with Card containers.
